'''2008 Match Play Championship Day 1 Mike French LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike French]] at [[2008 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Name on sheet:''' Michael French
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS14]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
